Synopsis:
    Protests erupted across Gambia over prolonged electricity blackouts (up to 48h), with police deploying tear gas near the presidential residence. The national utility NAWEC faces surging demand, unit failures and reduced hydropower output. President Barrow promised new generators this week and full restoration by end of October, alongside a 24 MW addition and a 50 MW solar contract. The crisis unfolds ahead of December presidential elections, adding political pressure.
